name: Frame Rate
desc: Retimes the engine's 30 Hz-bound systems for the rate the game actually runs at.
fhvrr.fps_overlay.name: FPS overlay
fhvrr.fps_overlay.desc: Shows render FPS / simulation passes per second in one compact line at the top right. Independent of the diagnostic window.
fhvrr.max_framerate.desc: Live cap for independent VRR rendering. 0 is unlimited; nonzero values are at least 30, e.g. 144. Requires an active supported VRR path. Native movies retain at most 60 render FPS.
fhvrr.simulation_framerate.desc: 30, 60 or 120 simulation ticks per second; default 60. Changes apply after restart. Movies retain their media clock. A JSON TargetFramerateOverride takes precedence.
fhvrr.max_framerate.name: Maximum render FPS (0 = unlimited)
fhvrr.simulation_framerate.name: Simulation / engine cutscenes (restart)
